description: Kinds of numbered, citable object a converted manuscript emits as a bold run-in header — '**Theorem 2.1.**'. These are the entries of the subject index: the things a paper states and then refers back to. Derived from the MARKDOWN rather than the LaTeX source, so the index is lane-agnostic and its offsets are computed on the final file; a source-derived index would be correct only for the LaTeX lane and would drift the moment the manuscript was repaired.
